data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence (Wikipedia, timeanddate, Booking, Viator ×2, OpenTable, note, mail, discard) and names most of the same parameters, but it leaves out several details: the review score ≥8 filter, the "do not click Reserve/Book" constraints, the exact note and email templates, and the specific activity1/activity2 and companion@example.com parameters, so an automation built from it alone would have to guess at those.
